full_judgment: 2. The present appellant, as plaintiff, filed the above mentioned Title Suit No. 33 of 1992 for recovery of khas possessions of the "Ga" schedule property by evicting the defendants there from. The case of the plaintiff, in short, was that 50 decimals land of plot Nos.526 to 530 of S.A. Khatian No. 463 of mouza Amanatganj Originally belonged to Ganoda Sundari and Lalit Kumar. The said Ganoda Sundari and Lalit Kumar died in the year 1948 and their heirs used to possess the same. That for arrears of rent the said property was sold in auction in a certificate proceeding bearing No. 2350/1957-58 and one Sahera Khatun, Araj Ali Sikder, Abdus Salam and Azizur Rahman purchased the same in auction on 23.11.1957 and got possession through court on 03.11.1960 and since then they had been possessing the same on payment of rent after mutating their names in the Government sheresta. That the auction purchasers filed a partition suit being numbered Title Suit No. 89 of 1967 among themselves and got their shares partitioned. Subsequently, the plaintiff purchased 12½ decimals of land from Azizur Rahman by registered deed dated 10.07.1968. The plaintiff also entered into a contract to purchase the share of Abdus Salam. Since Abdus Salam subsequently denied to execute the kabala deed as per that contract the plaintiff filed Title Suit No. 428 of 1974 for specific performance of contract in the name of the defendant No. 1-his benamder and got decree and thereafter Abdus . Salam executed the kabala deed in the name of the defendant No. 1 Azaharuddin. The further case of the plaintiffs was that the predecessor-in-interest of the defendant Nos. 2 to 4, namely, Mainuddin, Abdul Jabbar Ali and Abu Sufian Mia in collusion with the local administration and for the purpose of creating title, obtained a decree on the basis of a false rent suit in the name of Mothahar Hossain the brother-in-law of Abdul Jabbar Mia for which the auction purchasers along with Azaharuddin filed Title Suit No. 762 of 1975 in the 6th Court of Munsif, Barisal for declaration against the predecessor-in-interest of the defendant Nos.2 to 4 and that suit was decreed on 17.05.1976. Thereafter the auction purchaser Sharea Khatun and the plaintiff’s benamder Azharuddin Molla applied to the Deputy Commissioner, Barisal for giving them possession after evicting the allottees there from. The Deputy Commissioner, Barisal then filed Title Suit No. 343 of 1977 for cancellation of the decree dated 17.05.1976 passed in Title Suit No. 762 of 1975, but that suit subsequently abated. The Deputy Commissioner then passed orders for de-requisition of the house in Case Nos. 54 of 1948 and 60 of 1948 in the year 1987. That the defendant Nos. 2 to 4 being not allottees prayed for allotment after declaring the suit property as enemy property to continue with their illegal and unauthorized occupation but, no order was passed to that effect. The further case of the plaintiff was that after the death of Araj Ali Sikder, his heirs denied the plaintiffs title and for which the plaintiff filed Title Suit No. 143 of 1983 and got decree. Thus the plaintiff has got right, tile and interest over the suit land. But since the defendants denied to hand over possession of the suit property to the plaintiff lastly on 18.11.1988 the plaintiff filed the suit.
